rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with Google NotebookLM through browser automation using Playwright, enabling document querying and notebook library management with citation-backed responses. Features dual deployment modes supporting both MCP stdio protocol for direct integration and HTTP REST API for automation platforms like n8n, Zapier, and Make. Includes persistent Google authentication with managed browser sessions, auto-discovery for notebook metadata generation, multi-notebook library support, and stealth browsing capabilities to avoid detection.
